description:
Continuation of the landed-on-branch fz-k22.18/.14/.20 work (branch fz-k22.18/callable-entry-ownership @ f557a9c7d, evaluated 2026-07-11: architecture adopted; lib 1330/0/6; fz-pcd FIXED 10/2; enum_predicate_search::interp GREEN; actor_ring::interp GREEN; matrix delta 74->75). TWO blockers before fold:

1. REGRESSION (blocking): resource_index_payload_private::{run,build} HANGS (30s timeout, output stalls after nil) -- previously green. Not a clean diagnostic: likely a WRONG entry stamped for a position (or a mis-split capture prefix for the 1-published-lane-over-0-param body this fixture exercises -- the same benign-superset shape that false-fired the k22.19 registry variant) causing a runtime livelock. Root-cause first; never-worse-than-clean-crash is the branch standard.

2. UNSTAMPED ENTRIES: materialize_callable_entry_positions (jobs/backend.rs) stamps a position only on an EXACTLY-ONE entry match and silently skips multi-matches -- precisely the multi-resolution callables this epic exists for. Downstream clean errors: enum_predicate_search::run "closure call target 48 disagrees with resolved entry 0 target 47"; enum_take_drop_split::run "materialize direct-only callable CallableId(19) without its upstream resolved entry"; ::interp "no resolved entry identity or direct target". FIX: per-position disambiguation -- the positions own demand context (its executable/clause origin, its position shapes grounded surface) selects WHICH resolution; a position that genuinely reaches N resolutions needs N-aware handling (the entry identity is per-resolution; the position knows its grounding). Both blockers are likely the same root (position->entry mapping correctness).

ACCEPTANCE: resource_index_payload_private green again; enum_predicate_search + enum_take_drop_split green on run/interp/build (the epics goal); matrix name-set vs eae19c725 baseline shows ONLY removals (actor_ring::interp stays fixed, nothing new red); lib/clippy green; determinism retained (byte-identical repeat runs). Work on branch wt/k22-20-finish (based at f557a9c7d).
title: fz-k22: finish callable-entry ownership -- per-position entry disambiguation + resource_index_payload_private hang regression
